notes: Version 2.5.1 states, in the subsection on entanglement as a shared infra-projectable cell, that the matched-block result S_ent(n) = log r_pair(n) of ENT-E1 holds under a supplied purity of the joint state, which ENT-E1 does not derive, and that the general-block case is conditional on that purity and on a residual indiscernibility hypothesis. The ENT-E1 and ENT-E2 bibliography notes carry the same condition. No Foundation theorem is changed.
